Ornith-1.5-9B-MLX-distil-v2-oQ4.note: v2, measured on oMLX 2026-09-08. Worse than v1 on all three; not released.

Ornith-1.5-9B-MLX-distil-v4-oQ4.note: v4, oMLX 2026-09-10. Length-unbiased traces, v1 recipe. Not released; v1 still best.

Ornith-1.5-9B-MLX-distil-v5-oQ4.note: v5, logit-level distillation (0.3*CE + 0.7*KL over teacher top-64), oMLX 2026-09-12. First distil below stock oQ4 on MMLU, and 5.4x v1's wall clock on the same 1,000 questions -- a termination failure, not a reasoning failure. TruthfulQA and HumanEval were not run; the model was abandoned after MMLU. Not released.

Ornith-1.5-9B-MLX-distil-v7-oQ4.note: v7, oMLX 2026-09-13. Adapter capacity doubled (rank 64 vs 32, top-16 layers held), training data byte-identical to v1. All three deltas within ~1 SE of v1 and all negative. Adapter capacity is not the lever. Not released.

Ornith-1.5-9B-MLX-distil-v8-oQ4.note: v8, oMLX 2026-09-15. Error-conditioned data: 330 verified teacher traces on prompts v1 failed, continued from v1's fused bf16, 660 steps. Below v1 on all three; HumanEval -5.4 fired the pre-registered falsifier. Interpretation waits on v8ctl. Not released.

Ornith-1.5-9B-MLX-distil-v8ctl-oQ4.note: v8-control, oMLX 2026-09-16. Same recipe as v8 on 330 RANDOM prompts from the same pool. Also below v1 on all three; slightly above v8 but within noise. Wall clock +46-80% vs v1 (unexplained; v8 was +6-12%). Not released.

Ornith-1.5-9B-MLX-distil-v9-oQ4.note: v9, self-distillation of HALT traces. Not trained: the rollout yielded 27 (at 1,536) and ~9 projected (at 2,304) forced-correct code traces against the 150 the design required. Negative at the data stage; DECISIONS.md 46-48.

Ornith-1.5-9B-MLX-distil-v10-oQ4.note: v10, DPO+RPO on (teacher verified, student unterminated) pairs over v1. Harness only: HumanEval@2048 123/164 (30 truncated) vs v1 130 (24); step-150 checkpoint 116 (39). Symmetric churn, more truncation than v1, no termination shift. Not run on oMLX; not released.
